items.title: Scott Yanow interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 22, 2021
items.q: can add another dozen to that from Ornette Coleman

ctx.x: Well it wouldn’t be short of course, you know I can name a bunch. I think there are certain — my favorites who — well Louis Armstrong is my favorite of all of them. You know he’s my favorite jazz artist and there’s so much joy in his playing from all aspects of his career, any period. I love the way he phrases and the sound. But if I were to name two — the ones I think are the obvious ones that are the most important to jazz history there’d be six: Louis Armstrong, Duke Ellington, Charlie Parker, Dizzy Gillespie,…

can add another dozen to that from Ornette Coleman, maybe Chick Corea and Count Basie and you know, many, many others. But basically I have hundreds of favorites. So you’d have to say what time period.
